title: Fix stale report filename captions and cover language resolution
summary: Fixed a bug where the report filename resolver incorrectly returned true for nonexistent reports when the output value was already populated, and added language resolution coverage with regression tests.
key_points: Output is cleared before the metadata lookup, so nonexistent or zero report IDs now return false with empty output
Existing language selection for the report name caption is unchanged; only test coverage was added for it
Nine new AL regression tests cover explicit language, blank-code company default, caller-language restoration, translated and missing captions, and nonexistent reports
Two test-only reports and a checked-in de-DE translation fixture avoid relying on installed Base Application translations
Implementation comment now separates metadata resource selection from the report's effective rendering language
quote: Clear the output before resolving so nonexistent/zero report IDs return false and empty output.
